title: DeepSeek reportedly seeks $12 billion before 2027 IPO
summary: DeepSeek is reportedly nearing an $12 billion funding round backed by Tencent and CATL, underscoring the capital race behind Chinese AI.
body:
## Financing expands beyond the original target

DeepSeek is reportedly close to raising at least 80 billion yuan, or about $12 billion, in a new financing round ahead of a potential early-2027 initial public offering. The Business Times, citing people familiar with the matter, said the company originally sought roughly 50 billion yuan but attracted stronger-than-expected investor interest.

Tencent and Contemporary Amperex Technology are among the largest reported backers. The round is said to be nearing completion, although the final amount and terms remain private. Other reporting has described the possibility of a total approaching 100 billion yuan if additional commitments are included.

The reported financing would mark a major change in DeepSeek’s financial scale. The company became globally prominent after releasing models that challenged assumptions about the cost of competitive AI development. A much larger capital base would allow it to invest in training runs, inference capacity, data infrastructure and domestic-chip optimization, while preparing the governance and financial systems required for a public listing.

The numbers should still be treated as reported rather than finalized. Neither the final investor list nor the IPO timetable has been publicly confirmed in the cited accounts. A large round also creates a demanding test: DeepSeek would need to convert model attention and strategic backing into durable revenue while preserving the research pace and relatively open model strategy that made it influential.

## Why it matters

This is not simply another startup financing story. Tencent’s participation and CATL’s reported commitment would connect DeepSeek to two powerful industrial ecosystems, while the possible scale of the round suggests that China’s AI competition is becoming an infrastructure and capital-allocation contest as much as a model race. The prospective IPO would make that contest visible to public-market investors.
title_zh: DeepSeek据报拟融资120亿美元，冲刺2027年IPO
summary_zh: 据报道，DeepSeek正接近完成一轮至少800亿元人民币融资，腾讯和宁德时代是主要支持者，目标或指向2027年上市。
body_zh:
## 融资规模超过最初目标

据报道，DeepSeek正接近完成一轮至少800亿元人民币、约合120亿美元的新融资，并计划在可能于2027年初进行首次公开募股之前扩大资本储备。《商业时报》援引知情人士称，公司最初计划融资约500亿元人民币，但投资者兴趣超过预期。

据报道，腾讯和宁德时代是本轮最大支持者之一。融资接近完成，但最终金额和具体条款仍未公开。其他报道则称，如果纳入更多承诺，最终规模可能接近1000亿元人民币。

这笔融资若落地，将显著改变DeepSeek的财务体量。公司凭借一系列模型在全球走红，并改变了行业对高水平AI开发成本的部分判断。更充足的资本可以支持训练、推理容量、数据基础设施和国产芯片适配，同时帮助公司为上市建立所需的治理与财务体系。

不过，目前这些数字仍应视为媒体报道，而非已经完成的交易。相关报道尚未确认最终投资人名单和IPO时间表。大额融资也会带来新的考验：DeepSeek必须把模型关注度和战略支持转化为持续收入，同时维持使其获得影响力的研发速度与相对开放的模型路线。

## 为什么重要

这不只是又一宗创业公司融资消息。腾讯的参与和宁德时代据报投入的资金，会把DeepSeek连接到两个强大的产业生态；而融资规模本身也表明，中国AI竞争正在从模型能力比拼，扩展为基础设施和资本配置的较量。如果IPO推进，这场较量还将直接呈现在公开市场投资者面前。

cat_take_zh: 800亿元融资若属实，DeepSeek面对的最大问题将从能否突破转为能否证明商业化配得上估值。
cat_take_en: If the 80-billion-yuan round closes, DeepSeek’s harder question becomes whether revenue can justify the valuation it is building.
